xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="Mission vision"><e-flexbox configuration-id="MV head"><e-flexbox configuration-id="MV label row"><e-div-block configuration-id="MV rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="MV label"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="MV rule 2"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-heading configuration-id="MV title"></e-heading></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="MV cards"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Card Mission"><e-div-block configuration-id="Card Mission ring"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Card Mission num"></e-paragraph><e-heading configuration-id="Card Mission title"></e-heading><e-div-block configuration-id="Card Mission rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Card Mission body"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Card Vision"><e-div-block configuration-id="Card Vision ring"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Card Vision num"></e-paragraph><e-heading configuration-id="Card Vision title"></e-heading><e-div-block configuration-id="Card Vision rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Card Vision body"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

MV title.title: Purpose in every piece we supply.

Card Mission body.paragraph: To equip hospitality businesses with premium, dependable products and genuinely helpful service — so every team can deliver memorable guest experiences with confidence.

Card Vision body.paragraph: To be the most trusted hospitality supply partner in the region, recognised for curated quality, design-led thinking and long-term relationships with the venues we serve.

style.Mission vision: flex-direction: column; padding: 120px 100px; gap: 64px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; @media(--tablet){ padding: 96px 40px; gap: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 72px 20px; gap: 40px; } background: #FFFFFF;
style.MV head: flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; padding: 0px; align-items: center;
style.MV label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
style.MV rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.MV label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9962E; line-height: 1.2;
style.MV rule 2: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.MV title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 60px; line-height: 62px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 46px; line-height: 50px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 36px; line-height: 40px; } text-align: center; width: 820px; max-width: 100%;
style.MV cards: padding: 0px; gap: 24px; align-items: stretch; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; }
style.Card Mission: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 64px 56px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--on-navy); align-items: flex-start; @media(--tablet){ padding: 48px 36px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 44px 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 100%; }
style.Card Mission ring: position: absolute; left: 360px; top: -120px; width: 340px; height: 340px; min-width: 340px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.2px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.45); z-index: 0; @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -140px; } @media(--mobile){ left: auto; right: -160px; }
style.Card Mission num: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; letter-spacing: 0px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--on-gold-soft); z-index: 1;
style.Card Mission title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 48px; line-height: 50px; color: #FFFFFF; z-index: 1; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 38px; line-height: 42px; }
style.Card Mission rule: width: 64px; min-width: 64px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Card Mission body: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 29px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); z-index: 1;
style.Card Vision: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 64px 56px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--on-cream); align-items: flex-start; @media(--tablet){ padding: 48px 36px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 44px 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 100%; }
style.Card Vision ring: position: absolute; left: 360px; top: -120px; width: 340px; height: 340px; min-width: 340px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.2px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); z-index: 0; @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -140px; } @media(--mobile){ left: auto; right: -160px; }
style.Card Vision num: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; letter-spacing: 0px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; color: #C9962E; z-index: 1;
style.Card Vision title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 48px; line-height: 50px; color: var(--on-navy); z-index: 1; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 38px; line-height: 42px; }
style.Card Vision rule: width: 64px; min-width: 64px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Card Vision body: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 29px; color: var(--on-muted); z-index: 1;
